questions.question: Work out 3,45 km + 2,8 km and explain why you write 2,8 as 2,80.
questions.expected_answer: 2,80 has the same value as 2,8 and it lines up the hundredths. Hundredths: 5 plus 0 is 5. Tenths: 4 plus 8 is 12, so write 2 and carry 1. Units: 3 plus 2 plus 1 is 6. The total is 6,25 km.

questions.question: The bill is R74,24 and Zanele pays with R100. Work out the change and check it.
questions.expected_answer: Write R100 as R100,00 and subtract R74,24, borrowing from the tens. The change is R25,76. Check by adding R25,76 and R74,24, which gives R100,00.

questions.question: Estimate R16,99 + R24,50 + R32,75 and say why the estimate is useful.
questions.expected_answer: Round to R17, R25 and R33. Their sum is R75. The exact answer of R74,24 is close to R75, so it is sensible, and the estimate would show up a comma in the wrong place.
